`umami-kotlin` is a Kotlin Multiplatform Umami REST wrapper. Modules: `:umami`, `:sample:simple-compose-app`, `:sample:terminalApp`. `:umami` packages: `api`, `core`, `domain`. Uses Ktor, Kotlinx Coroutines, Kotlinx Serialization, `kotlin.time.Instant`, Kermit, Mokkery; Kotest matchers (e.g., `shouldBe`) for new tests.

All contributions must adhere to the guidelines outlined in [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](./CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [`CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

Detekt: `detekt/detekt.yml` (runs before git push); Qlty: `.qlty/qlty.toml`. Please ensure your changes do not introduce any new static analysis issues. Kover coverage requirements are in root `build.gradle.kts`.

All new features must be accompanied by tests. Bug fixes should also include a test that reproduces the bug. Verify modified modules with:
./gradlew :umami:jvmTest
./gradlew :umami-api:jvmTest
./gradlew :sample:terminalApp:jvmTest
Docs: `./gradlew dokkaHtml`.

NEVER assume a library/framework is available or appropriate. Verify its established usage within the project
